title: oncidium neovierlingii
intro: Oncidium neovierlingii, commonly known as the Pink Oncidium, is a type of flowering orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its vibrant pink flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oncidium neovierlingii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
